reason: The first eight proposals describe the same 16-call panel32 wrapper experiment. Rank that single legal layout change first: helper ABI checks and full-kernel baseline evidence support testing it, but no panel-path performance is measured, and repeated packing plus SME transitions are correctness and performance risks. B-panel packing has unresolved compatibility with the generated kernel and adds a full-matrix copy. Tail alignment affects only the general-size fallback, not the n=512 timed path.
